chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Salih ibn al-Sindi, from Ja'far ibn Bashir; and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Faddal; all together from Abu Jamilah, from Khalid ibn Ammar, from Sadir, who said:

I heard Abu Ja'far عليه السلام while he was entering and I was leaving. He took my hand, then faced the House, and said: “O Sadir, the people have only been commanded to come to these stones and circumambulate them, then come to us and inform us of their wilayah toward us.”
And this is the saying of Allah: “And indeed I am surely most forgiving to whoever repents and believes and acts righteously, then is guided.”
Then he gestured with his hand to his chest: “To our wilayah.”

Then he said: “O Sadir, shall I show you those who bar people from the religion of Allah?” Then he looked toward Abu Hanifah and Sufyan al-Thawri in that time, while they were circles in the mosque, and said: “These are the ones who bar from the religion of Allah without guidance from Allah and without a clear Book.”

Indeed, these vile ones—if they were to sit in their houses, and the people went about and found no one to inform them about Allah, Blessed and Exalted, and about His Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله, then they would come to us, and we would inform them about Allah, Blessed and Exalted, and about His Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله.”

key_terms.الصَّادِّينَ: those who hinder or turn people away from Allah's religion
key_terms.الْأَحْجَارَ: the stones of the Ka'bah around which tawaf is performed
key_terms.الْبَيْتَ: the Ka'bah, the sacred House toward which the Imam turned
key_terms.اهْتَدَى: was rightly guided, understood here in connection with true divinely guided authority
key_terms.دِينِ اللَّهِ: the religion of Allah in its true and divinely guided form
key_terms.كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ: a clear Book, meaning manifest divine proof
key_terms.وَلَايَتَهُمْ: their acknowledgment of loyal devotion and authority toward the Imams عليهم السلام

ai.seo_question: Why does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say people must come to the Imam after visiting the Ka'bah?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that after performing the rites connected to the Ka'bah, people are meant to come to the Imam for true guidance in religion and to manifest their wilayah to Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. It also presents the cited Quran verse as referring to guidance through their wilayah and warns against religious authorities who divert الناس from divinely guided leadership.
